verdict.rationale: Docs show core building blocks that would let ops reconstruct a transaction — address normalization/jurisdiction resolution (anrok-docs-11), product tax category assignment (anrok-docs-26), transaction storage tied to a specific tax return (anrok-docs-6), and filings retrieval (anrok-docs-12) — plus AI Atlas answering questions 'grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates' with reasoning shown (anrok-docs-15). However there is no explicit documentation of a per-transaction audit trail or export feature that packages the rate, rule citation, address resolution, and category together for audit purposes. Missing for 10: dedicated audit-log/export endpoint or UI feature, explicit rate/rule justification retention, independent/customer confirmation of audit reconstructability.
